reviews.review_title: Decent game but could use work
reviews.review_description:
I like the idea of the game, but the gameplay is kind of lacking. I think shock should be its own mode and have the monster appear on the scan levels, so you have to manage the scans while worrying about Mr meat man. I also found a bug where sometimes the gun wont respawn if you die, soft locking me and forcing me to restart😕.

overall, a pretty fun game but it certainly needs some tweaks here and there👍.

This game is very cool and you get the hang of the mechanics pretty quick and it becomes super fun. At some parts it feels like FNAF, which is awesome, I hope more can be added to the game over time. I very much like the parts of the game where you have to do tasks while the monster is trying to reach you.
I already gifted the game to 2 people because of how good it was
Game is really fun, and well made. I recommend giving it a try.
